symptom: Commercial intelligence, candidate materialization, provider execution, outcomes and learning could be individually healthy without one terminally proven lineage.
Heavy intelligence refresh on the latency-critical heartbeat could block or time out unrelated commercial execution.
GitHub delivery could be blocked by missing closure evidence, missing PR machine metadata, unsafe SECURITY DEFINER execute defaults, or leaked Supabase preview branches.
root_cause: Runtime ownership and delivery ownership were not expressed as one canonical closed-loop contract.
SECURITY DEFINER functions were created in public without explicit fail-closed EXECUTE revocation.
Closed PR preview branches were not reliably reclaimed, exhausting Supabase branch capacity.
prevention: Keep one canonical candidate materializer and one commercial closed-loop owner.
Run heavy enrichment asynchronously and consume bounded read models on the critical path.
Require provider acknowledgment before executed actions become terminal outcome evidence.
Materialize no-response as an observed outcome after the defined window rather than treating silence as success or rejection.
Revoke PUBLIC, anon and authenticated EXECUTE on every privileged function and grant only trusted server execution.
Treat exact-head full checkset plus production/readback closure as the only terminal delivery authority.
Reclaim preview branches for merged/closed PRs so branch capacity cannot silently block future delivery.
